evals.prompt: Let's pick up PROJ-142 and start working on it.
evals.expected_output: Reads the tracker item (and any directly-linked spec) read-only, digests goal + acceptance-criteria checklist, plans in plan-mode, and defers the move to In Progress until plan approval.
assertions: Reads the item before planning without mutating it
Produces an acceptance-criteria checklist from the item
Does not transition the item until the plan is approved via ExitPlanMode

evals.prompt: Kick off this ticket for me.
evals.expected_output: Auto-detects the issue key from the branch name or recent commits when no ID is given, then reads and plans.
assertions: Attempts to identify the issue key from the branch name or <base>..HEAD commits when none is supplied
Falls back to a 'mine, not started' picker or the no-item path when none is found
Defers any In Progress move until after plan approval

evals.prompt: I want to start some work but there's no ticket for it yet — can you get me going?
evals.expected_output: Offers to create a tracker item, drafts a title+description from the scoped intent for confirmation, gathers parent/sprint/assignee, and defers creation until plan approval.
assertions: Offers to create an item and drafts a title + description for confirmation
Treats item creation as a deferred mutation, not something done while planning
If creation is declined, drafts the item into the plan file instead

evals.prompt: Start work on ISSUE-8; the ticket links a PRD I want you to read first.
evals.expected_output: Pulls the directly-linked spec doc read-only as planning context alongside the item digest, then plans.
assertions: Reads the directly-linked spec document as read-only planning context
Incorporates the spec into the plan rather than inventing item content
Discovers the In Progress transition by matching target status, not transition display name

evals.prompt: Pick up my next unstarted ticket and get it moving.
evals.expected_output: Queries the tracker for the user's not-started items, offers a picker, reads the chosen item, plans, and moves it to In Progress only after approval.
assertions: Queries for items assigned to the user with a not-started status
Reads the selected item read-only and plans in plan-mode
Moves the item to In Progress best-effort only after ExitPlanMode, skipping silently when none applies
